clusters.name: The Great Reckoning
clusters.blurb: “Dark to Light” — the throughline that hidden crimes of a prior establishment (Russiagate, the Epstein network, election fraud) are being exposed and prosecuted. The spine of the vault's worldview.
landmarks: Risks From Perkins Coie (the lawfare campaign)

clusters.name: War Footing — Iran & the Mideast
clusters.blurb: Escalation toward open conflict with Iran: military buildup, Israel, terror framing, the Strait of Hormuz as a recurring flashpoint.
landmarks: Addressing threats from the Government of Iran

clusters.name: The Monetary Reset
clusters.blurb: A financial-system transition story — XRP/Ripple and stablecoins, the Fed and Treasury, BRICS de-dollarization. The crypto folder is dominated specifically by the XRP community.

clusters.name: Border & Homeland
clusters.blurb: ICE enforcement, sanctuary-state conflict (California, New York, Minnesota), and the civil-unrest / policing response.
landmarks: Fentanyl as a Weapon of Mass Destruction

clusters.name: Great-Power Realignment
clusters.blurb: The international board — China and Russia as rivals, the war in Ukraine, BRICS, and the rest of the foreign theatre.

clusters.name: The Information War
clusters.blurb: Legitimacy and narrative control — media distrust, the courts, AI and platforms, the partisan fight over what is true.
landmarks: Removing barriers to American AI leadership

clusters.name: Fringe, Disclosure & Health
clusters.blurb: The esoteric edge that braids back into the reckoning — Q and disclosure, alt-theories, health/biosecurity, weather and exotic science.
landmarks: Withdrawing from the World Health Organization
